medium.en: Sumi ink on washi; fusuma construction (wooden lattice, layered paper), wooden edge
medium.ja: 和紙に墨、襖の構造（木の骨・下張り）、木の縁

summary.en: One character. The rest is space.

description.en: A single brush character placed low on a deep field of white. The panel is built the way a fusuma is built — a wooden lattice, layers of paper, a wooden edge — so the frame is part of the work, not around it.
description.ja: 白い面の低い位置に、筆の一文字だけを置きます。襖と同じく、木の骨・何層もの紙・木の縁でつくるため、縁は作品を囲む額ではなく、作品の一部になります。

medium.en: Sumi ink on washi; fusuma construction, wooden edge, hikite (recessed pull); diptych
medium.ja: 和紙に墨、襖の構造、木の縁、引手。2枚組

summary.ja: 二枚の襖に、ひと筆の流れ。

description.en: Fusuma are made in pairs. TSUI follows that rule: one brushstroke runs across two panels, and the space you leave between them on the wall becomes part of the composition.
description.ja: 襖は2枚1組で使われます。TSUI はその決まりにならい、ひと筆の流れが2枚にまたがります。壁に掛けたときの2枚のすき間も、構図の一部になります。

medium.en: Printed paper pattern, sumi ink finished by hand, hikite (recessed pull), wooden edge
medium.ja: 文様紙、手で仕上げる墨、引手、木の縁

summary.en: A small door to a quiet room.
summary.ja: 静かな部屋への、小さな入口。

description.en: The hikite — the recessed pull you touch every day — becomes the centre of a small square work. Each piece in the edition shares one pattern and receives its own brushstroke by hand, so no two are exactly alike.
description.ja: 毎日ふれる小さなくぼみ「引手」を主役にした小品です。同じ文様の上に1点ずつ手で墨の一筆を加えるため、同じエディションでも一つとして同じものはありません。
